Key Successes

this month
  • ESN AppFirst end-to-end transaction completed. A key milestone for the new ESN App, done in TestFlight.
  • IMSInfluencer Marketing Solution launched. The Influencer Marketing team now has scalable operational tooling.
  • B2BGlobal key accounts onboarded. Superdrug and Rewe International went live via Elsdorf, driving international B2B market growth.
  • OMAZendesk ticket routing automated. Order-complaint tickets are now routed via n8n without manual triage.
  • FinanceSelf-service reprocessing for eClear Tax. Tax managers can now resolve failed transactions independently.
  • DWHHourly data ingestion live. All sources switched from daily to hourly loads, enabling near-real-time reporting.→

Coming Up

what's next

Selected priorities heading into October, in the words of the teams driving them.

  • ESN ShopContinue rolling out new discount, pricing and variant-availability features
  • IMSInfluencer Data Integration Module launching, tracking creator revenue and commissions
  • B2BPreparing go-live of further B2B accounts: Boots, Kruidvat, Shopapotheke, Galaxus, Coop, Migros
  • ProductionNutrient sync between Centric and LIMS, including a concept for attaching supplier specification PDFs to batches
  • PlanningDemand Planning: fifth sprint starting, plus sample data for Supply Planning
  • MajestixELMS 2: milestone defined, implementation kicked off with ESA, Reply and SmartR
  • OMAAutomated self-service returns for MORE, mirroring the ESN setup
  • Stock MgmtExpiry- and lot-based stock segmentation with B2B3 allocation logic in Fluent
  • SAPB2B3 to SAP & Fluent integration: Milestone 2 rollout in October, Milestone 3 implementation starts
  • SAPVAS process architecture and an SAP BoM proof of concept for the FIEGE pilot

LEA Core Update remains on hold

The required downtime of more than 40 hours means the update to LEA Core 3.15 stays paused. Reply has been made aware of the criticality and is evaluating solutions to reduce the downtime, with a timely discussion planned.
